Just landed in Beijing - China.   Will be live from Beijing tomorrow.


johnny dollar (@johnnydollar)

Tonight @johnrobertsFox is pinch-hitting for @BretBaier on @SpecialReport. Tune in to cable's news hour of record, LIVE NOW coast to coast and around the world!





— https://nitter.net/johnnydollar/status/2054321293147688993#m

As President Trump heads to Beijing for the critical summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping @SpecialReport is on the ground. Friday I’ll sit down with the President from Beijing 6pmET on @foxnews! #foxnews #specialreport  #china

Video

Thank you Salena!


ZitoSalena (@ZitoSalena)

Bret Baier meets this moment in his book arguing the very American qualities of perseverance, ability to endure, & our aspirations toward each other, instead of a tribal instinct to divide, all remain tightly bound 250 years after 56 men, all possessing incredible courage and resolve, signed the Declaration of Independence. washingtonexaminer.com/opini…





— https://nitter.net/ZitoSalena/status/2053863238341628069#m

Just landed in Beijing. Got a busy couple days hosting #specialreport live from Beijing and an interview with @President Donald J Trump. Be sure to tune in to see it all #china #beijing #trump #travel
China is shifting away from “sitting on the fence” to pressure Iran as the Strait of Hormuz conflict begins to damage Beijing’s own economic interests #specialreport #china #iran #nationalsecurity
Former Australian PM Kevin Rudd argues that President Trumps unpredictability plays as an advantage for America #trump #china #foreignpolicy

I sat down with former Australian PM Kevin Rudd to discuss the complex relationship between the two leaders and whether a “stabilized” partnership is possible amid rising global tensions #specialreport #trump #china #foreignpolicy

Fridays panel discussed the high-stakes wait for Iran’s response to the U.S. peace proposal. The conflict is hitting home as gas prices rise ahead of midterms #specialreport #trump #iran #gas #midterms
An amazing turnout at at Vero Beach Book Center for #thecaseforamerica — we sold out of books!  Great people.

Senators Elissa Slotkin and Bernie Moreno discuss a new bipartisan push to ban Chinese-made vehicles and connected technology from U.S. roads, citing major national security and economic risks. #bipartisan #commonground #autoindustry #china

UFO whistleblower David Grusch joins me tonight to weigh in on the “historically significant” release of government USP files and what disclosures could be coming next. #specialreport #uap #breakingnews

Thank you all for sending in your cases for America this week! Please continue to do so on my website, thecaseforamerica.com, where you can also order my book. I'll be signing books at @Raptis Rare Books this Friday and Vero Beach Book Center this Saturday. Next week, I'm heading to Beijing with the President and bringing #specialreport on the road with us! #caseforamerica #book
